# C S Rushil & Co.
> Chartered accountancy firm in Anna Nagar, Chennai, founded in 2024 by CA Rushil C S
> (Certified FAFD, Start-up Mentor) with a 16-member team — company incorporation, GST,
> audit, direct tax, ROC compliance, and virtual CFO services. Consultations in English,
> Tamil, and Hindi. Remote service available for NRI and overseas clients.

## Services
- [Private Limited Company Incorporation Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/private-limited-company-incorporation-chennai): SPICe+ incorporation process, entity comparison, timelines
- [Formation of Business Entity](https://www.csrushil.com/formation-of-business-entity): Choosing and registering the right structure (Pvt Ltd, LLP, OPC, Partnership, Proprietorship)
- [LLP Registration Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/llp-registration-chennai): FiLLiP filing, LLP Agreement drafting, conversion from partnership
- [Company Registration Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/company-registration-chennai): Private Limited, LLP, and OPC registration
- [GST Litigation Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-chennai): Show-cause notice replies, appeals, GST Appellate Tribunal representation
- [Goods & Services Tax](https://www.csrushil.com/goods-and-services-tax): GST registration, return filing, amendments, cancellations
- [GST Registration Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-registration-chennai): New GST registration, amendments, LUT applications
- [Audit & Assurance](https://www.csrushil.com/audit-and-assurance): Statutory, internal, tax, transfer pricing, forensic, and stock audits
- [Statutory Audit Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/statutory-audit-chennai): Companies Act audit under Section 139
- [Tax Audit Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/tax-audit-chennai): Section 44AB tax audit, Form 3CA/3CB/3CD
- [Transfer Pricing Audit](https://www.csrushil.com/transfer-pricing-audit): Form 3CEB, arm's-length pricing documentation
- [Direct Tax](https://www.csrushil.com/direct-tax): Income tax planning, return filing, assessment representation
- [Income Tax Return Filing Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/income-tax-return-filing-chennai): ITR filing for individuals, professionals, NRIs, and businesses
- [MSME / Udyam Registration Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/msme-udyam-registration-chennai): Udyam registration process and MSMED Act benefits
- [ROC Compliances](https://www.csrushil.com/roc-compliances): Annual filings, statutory registers, DIR-3 KYC
- [Virtual CFO Services](https://www.csrushil.com/virtual-cfo-services): MIS reporting, budgeting, fundraising support
- [Management Consultancy](https://www.csrushil.com/management-consultancy): Business process, risk, and growth advisory
- [RERA Compliance](https://www.csrushil.com/rera): Project registration, QPR filings for Tamil Nadu developers
- [Trust & NGO Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/trust): Trust deed, Society, Section 8 Company, 12A/80G registration
- [CA Fees & Pricing](https://www.csrushil.com/ca-fees-chennai): Indicative pricing for incorporation, GST, and audit services

## Specialist services (NRIs, overseas businesses, notices)
- [NRI Tax Services](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services): Hub for Indian tax, DTAA and repatriation for NRIs
- [NRI Tax Services — UAE](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services-uae): India–UAE DTAA, TRC, deemed-residency rule, NRE/NRO
- [NRI Tax Services — UK](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services-uk): India–UK DTAA, figures for HMRC Self Assessment
- [NRI Tax Services — USA](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services-usa): India–US DTAA, data for foreign tax credit, FBAR/FATCA
- [NRI Property Sale TDS (Chennai)](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-property-sale-tds-chennai): Lower-deduction certificate, capital gains, Form 15CA/15CB, repatriation
- [GST Notice Reply Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-notice-reply-chennai): ASMT-10, DRC-01A, DRC-01, ADT-01 and RFD-08 replies
- [Income Tax Notice Reply Chennai](https://www.csrushil.com/income-tax-notice-reply-chennai): Intimations, defective returns, scrutiny and reassessment
- [Company Registration in India for Foreigners](https://www.csrushil.com/company-registration-india-for-foreigners): Subsidiary, LLP or branch; FDI route, FC-GPR, resident director rule
- [India Subsidiary Compliance & CFO](https://www.csrushil.com/india-subsidiary-compliance-cfo): Audit, ROC, FEMA, transfer pricing, GST, payroll and group reporting
- [Outsourced Accounting for US CPA Firms](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-accounting-for-cpa-firms): Bookkeeping and tax-prep support for CPA review, Section 7216-aware
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping for UK Practices](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-accounting-for-uk-accountants): Bookkeeping, MTD VAT and year-end accounts for practice review
